title: Malay Vegetable Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry dish made with rich coconut milk and a variety of vegetables. Perfect for a vegetarian dinner option.

ingredients.name: Green beans
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the turmeric, cumin, and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in the green beans and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
